STORAGE_BUCKET.description: GCS bucket name (globally unique). Created if missing; AuthGlow data and the JWT keyring are stored under it.

SECRET_KEY.description: Encryption key (32+ chars) for sessions, signed cookies and the JWT keyring at rest. Generated if left blank.

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated origins allowed to call the API. Same-origin is used by default; set to your Cloud Run URL if you call the API from another app.

commands: gsutil ls gs://$STORAGE_BUCKET 2>/dev/null || gcloud storage buckets create gs://$STORAGE_BUCKET --project=$GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT --location=$GOOGLE_CLOUD_REGION
